[LLEX.10.8.4] **The single `NAME` terminal is unambiguous at three points**;
[LGRA.22.3] owns the unambiguity guarantee. The pattern head
`type_ref binding?` is decided by the token that follows the head: a `NAME`
begins a binding, a `.` continues a qualified head, and anything else ends the
pattern; the binding is optional ([LGRA.8.6]). The expression `atom` versus
`function_call` split is decided by the following `(` or `.`. The suffix chain
interleaving `slot_suffix` and `cast_suffix` on one atom is decided by the
following `.`, `[` or `::` ([LGRA.9.6]). What a dotted chain denotes is not the
lexer's or the grammar's to decide ([LGRA.22.9]).
